en:
<CLT=cltMIND>We decided to hang out
in the AV room.

<CLT=cltMIND>It looks like we're the only ones here...
What should we do?
Watch an action movie
Watch a comedy movie
Watch an anime movie
Hmmm...

Action-y movies make me tired. 
They're too stressful.

It makes sense when 
you think about it.

A regular girl who can use magic 
and action movies just don't mix.

I like these kinds of movies. 
They're easy to watch.

There are no annoying mysteries or 
problems and I cry at the end...

Does that mean I've matured?
I've been crying a lot, recently...

I see. A movie fit for a mage.
It's not a bad idea, but...

Magical girl anime are 
different from reality...

But I get excited watching them, anyway.
I want to be able to transform, too.

<CLT=cltMIND>I wonder what's wrong?
Himiko looks deep in thought...
(Nyeh...)
<CLT=cltMIND>Huh?
<CLT=cltMIND>That voice just now. Is that...?
<CLT=cltMIND>Is that Himiko's inner thoughts...?
